output.message: I agree with Agents D2, D7, D5, and D1: Sell remains more defensible than Strong Sell. Monitor customer retention, organic revenue quality, R&D-to-revenue trends, operating cash flow, and funding runway. Reassess if the core business stabilizes and AI partnerships deliver measurable revenue and margins without weakening cash generation.
output.thought: Based on the supplied qualitative information, weakening core software demand and declining client confidence undermine revenue sustainability. R&D spending above industry norms increases execution risk and could pressure margins and cash generation unless it produces commercial returns. Partnership and AI announcements do not establish those returns. No verified financial statements, valuation metrics, or detailed news reports are provided, limiting conviction about downside magnitude.
